His natural talent, which bested everyone around him and made him a dazzling light in the face of all friends and foes he built along the way, had made Manabu Horikita inspire his inferiors to follow in his footsteps. It is somewhere around that time where Horikita had begun to develop a utilitarian ideology which strives to develop and achieve the greater good for everyone according to their own share of merit.

The one inspired the most by Manabu Horikita’s innate superiority and genius was his little sister Suzune, who began to feel a definitive complex of inferiority to her brother and a desperate need to follow in his footsteps in order to earn his approval.
